lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Rodentine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Young Twilight Stormvermin
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Twilight Stormvermin. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Twilight Stormvermins in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Twilight Stormvermin
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Twilight Stormvermin
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Twilight Stormvermin bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Twilight Stormvermin
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Twilight Stormvermin — Berserker Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Berserker path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Twilight Stormvermin is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Chaos Wastes. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

star_6.name: Twilight Stormvermin the True
star_6.appearance: Twilight Stormvermin now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Twilight Stormvermins have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Mark of the Eternal Warlord

star_7.name: Sublime Twilight Stormvermin
star_7.appearance: The final form. Twilight Stormvermin stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Warborn-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Newborn Sacred Chaos Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sacred Chaos Champion. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Sacred Chaos Champions in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Sacred Chaos Champion
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Kindling Sinuous Warhound V

base_chain.name: Spawn Gutter Runner Corrupted

base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Young Plague Rat IV
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Plague Rat IV. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Plague Rat IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Emerging Plague Rat IV
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Wisp Shadowed Plague Censer

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Shadowed Plague Censers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Bud Shard Fleshhound

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Shard Fleshhounds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Shard Fleshhound
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Lesser Night Marauder Awakened
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Night Marauder Awakened. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Night Marauder Awakeneds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Night Marauder Awakened
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Night Marauder Awakened
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Night Marauder Awakened bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Night Marauder Awakened
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Night Marauder Awakened — Berserker Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Berserker path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Night Marauder Awakened is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Chaos Wastes. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Night Marauder Awakened Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Night Marauder Awakened now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Night Marauder Awakeneds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Mark of the Eternal Warlord

star_7.name: Legend Night Marauder Awakened
star_7.appearance: The final form. Night Marauder Awakened stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Night Marauder Awakened is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Eternal Warpath" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Wisp Spectral Chosen of Chaos
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Spectral Chosen of Chaos. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Spectral Chosen of Chaoss in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Spectral Chosen of Chaos
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Spectral Chosen of Chaos
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Spectral Chosen of Chaos bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Spectral Chosen of Chaos
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Spectral Chosen of Chaos — Berserker Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Berserker path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Spectral Chosen of Chaos is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Chaos Wastes. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Spectral Chosen of Chaos the Last
star_6.appearance: Spectral Chosen of Chaos now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Spectral Chosen of Chaoss have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Mark of the Eternal Warlord

star_7.name: Origin Spectral Chosen of Chaos
star_7.appearance: The final form. Spectral Chosen of Chaos stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Spectral Chosen of Chaos is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Eternal Warpath" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

base_chain.name: Wisp Obsidian Plague Censer

base_chain.name: Seed Corrupted Rat Ogre
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Corrupted Rat Ogre. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Corrupted Rat Ogres in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Emerging Corrupted Rat Ogre

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Insectoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Pup Dominant Exalted Daemon Prince
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dominant Exalted Daemon Prince. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Dominant Exalted Daemon Princes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Dominant Exalted Daemon Prince
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Spawn Shroud Chaos Warrior VI

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Shroud Chaos Warrior VIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Kindling Shroud Chaos Warrior VI

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Blood Court-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Lesser Swamp Blood Seeker
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Swamp Blood Seeker. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Swamp Blood Seekers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Swamp Blood Seeker
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Swamp Blood Seeker

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Pup Shard Dark Warrior

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Shard Dark Warriors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Shard Dark Warrior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Wisp Lanky Mutt

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Stirring Lanky Mutt

base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Warborn-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Void Chaos Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Void Chaos Champion. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Void Chaos Champions in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Void Chaos Champion
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.name: Wisp Scourge Plague Priest
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Scourge Plague Priest. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Scourge Plague Priests in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Scourge Plague Priest
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Lesser Tattered Raider Omega
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Tattered Raider Omega. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Tattered Raider Omegas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Stirring Tattered Raider Omega
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Tattered Raider Omega
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Tattered Raider Omega bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Tattered Raider Omega
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Young Ragged Mongrel Blessed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ragged Mongrel Blessed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Ragged Mongrel Blesseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Kindling Ragged Mongrel Blessed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Ragged Mongrel Blessed
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Ragged Mongrel Blessed bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Ragged Mongrel Blessed
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Ragged Mongrel Blessed — Berserker Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Berserker path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Ragged Mongrel Blessed is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Chaos Wastes. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_6.name: Ragged Mongrel Blessed the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Ragged Mongrel Blessed now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Ragged Mongrel Blesseds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Mark of the Eternal Warlord

star_7.name: Last Form Ragged Mongrel Blessed
star_7.appearance: The final form. Ragged Mongrel Blessed stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Ragged Mongrel Blessed is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Eternal Warpath" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Seed Pink Horror VI

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Pink Horror VIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Spawn Sludge Brute Young
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sludge Brute Young. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Sludge Brute Youngs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Emerging Sludge Brute Young
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Pup Hallowed Exalted Daemon Prince

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Hallowed Exalted Daemon Princes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Hallowed Exalted Daemon Prince
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Lithic-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Seed Crystal Plague Censer
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Crystal Plague Censer. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Crystal Plague Censers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Emerging Crystal Plague Censer
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Crystal Plague Censer
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Crystal Plague Censer bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Young Gorebeast V

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Gorebeast Vs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Gorebeast V
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Void Skaven Warlord

base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Bud Colossus Daemon Prince of Tzeentch

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Kindling Colossus Daemon Prince of Tzeentch

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.name: Seed Risen Bloodthirster Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Risen Bloodthirster Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Risen Bloodthirster Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Risen Bloodthirster Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Young Blue Horror Blessed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Blue Horror Blessed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Blue Horror Blesseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Blue Horror Blessed

tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Lesser Raging Chosen of Chaos
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Raging Chosen of Chaos. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Raging Chosen of Chaoss in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Raging Chosen of Chaos
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Raging Chosen of Chaos
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Raging Chosen of Chaos bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Raging Chosen of Chaos
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Raging Chosen of Chaos — Berserker Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Berserker path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Raging Chosen of Chaos is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Chaos Wastes. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_6.name: Raging Chosen of Chaos of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: Raging Chosen of Chaos now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Raging Chosen of Chaoss have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Mark of the Eternal Warlord

star_7.name: Final Raging Chosen of Chaos
star_7.appearance: The final form. Raging Chosen of Chaos stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Raging Chosen of Chaos is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Eternal Warpath" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Celestial-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. base_chain.name: Young Celestial Plague Censer
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Celestial Plague Censer. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Celestial Plague Censers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Celestial Plague Censer
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: First-Form Thorn Plaguebearer Prime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Barbed Gutter Runner Primes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Barbed Gutter Runner Prime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.name: Pup Dark Warrior VII

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Dark Warrior VIIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Warlord Skaven General
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Warlord Skaven General bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Warlord Skaven General
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Warlord Skaven General — Berserker Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Berserker path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Warlord Skaven General is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Chaos Wastes. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_6.name: Warlord Skaven General the Revered
star_6.appearance: Warlord Skaven General now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Warlord Skaven Generals have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Mark of the Eternal Warlord

base_chain.name: Hatchling Abyss Khorne Herald
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Abyss Khorne Herald. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Abyss Khorne Heralds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Abyss Khorne Herald
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Looter
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Looter. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Looters in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Stirring Looter
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Newborn Plague Carrier
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Plague Carrier. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Plague Carriers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Plague Carrier
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Fledgling Berserker Greater

base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Scourge Chaos Champion — Berserker Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Berserker path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Scourge Chaos Champion is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Chaos Wastes. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Scourge Chaos Champion the Undying
star_6.appearance: Scourge Chaos Champion now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Scourge Chaos Champions have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Mark of the Eternal Warlord

star_7.name: Apex Scourge Chaos Champion
star_7.appearance: The final form. Scourge Chaos Champion stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Scourge Chaos Champion is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Eternal Warpath" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Wisp Apocalypse Verminlord Warmaster

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Apocalypse Verminlord Warmasters in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Lesser Sinuous Blood Knight
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sinuous Blood Knight. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Sinuous Blood Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Rising Sinuous Blood Knight
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Sinuous Blood Knight
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Sinuous Blood Knight bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Bud Astral Doom-wheel

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Emerging Astral Doom-wheel

base_chain.name: Bud Plague Monk Major
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Plague Monk Major. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Plague Monk Majors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Awakened Plague Monk Major
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Spawn Titan Plague Censer

base_chain.name: Kindling Titan Plague Censer

base_chain.name: Pup Ragged Thug Cursed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ragged Thug Cursed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Ragged Thug Curseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Emerging Ragged Thug Cursed

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Lupine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Wisp Fleshhound I
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Fleshhound I. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Fleshhound Is in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Fleshhound I
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration
