lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Bud Cardinal Great Unclean Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Cardinal Great Unclean Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Cardinal Great Unclean Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Cardinal Great Unclean Minor
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.name: Seed Commander Exalted Daemon Prince

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Commander Exalted Daemon Princes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Commander Exalted Daemon Prince

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Lesser Ragged Sewer Rat

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Ragged Sewer Rats in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Ragged Sewer Rat

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Bud Warhound Feral

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Warhound Ferals in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Warhound Feral

base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Pup Infernal Skaven Warlord
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Infernal Skaven Warlord. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Infernal Skaven Warlords in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Awakened Infernal Skaven Warlord
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Infernal Skaven Warlord
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Infernal Skaven Warlord bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Branded Infernal Skaven Warlord
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Infernal Skaven Warlord — Berserker Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Berserker path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Infernal Skaven Warlord is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Chaos Wastes. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

star_6.name: Infernal Skaven Warlord the First
star_6.appearance: Infernal Skaven Warlord now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Infernal Skaven Warlords have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Mark of the Eternal Warlord

star_7.name: Sublime Infernal Skaven Warlord
star_7.appearance: The final form. Infernal Skaven Warlord stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Infernal Skaven Warlord is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Eternal Warpath" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Celestial-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Wisp Celestial Slaanesh Herald
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Celestial Slaanesh Herald. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Celestial Slaanesh Heralds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Celestial Slaanesh Herald
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Celestial Slaanesh Herald
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Celestial Slaanesh Herald bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Rising Raging Slaanesh Herald

base_chain.name: Bud Raider V

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Raider Vs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Awakened Raider V

base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Newborn Gale Night Runner Lesser
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Gale Night Runner Lesser. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Gale Night Runner Lessers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Gale Night Runner Lesser
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Newborn Immortal Great Unclean Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Immortal Great Unclean Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Immortal Great Unclean Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Immortal Great Unclean Minor
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Immortal Great Unclean Minor
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Immortal Great Unclean Minor bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Immortal Great Unclean Minor
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Immortal Great Unclean Minor — Berserker Sovereign

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Berserker Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Immortal Great Unclean Minor is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Chaos Wastes. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Immortal Great Unclean Minor the Last
star_6.appearance: Immortal Great Unclean Minor now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Immortal Great Unclean Minors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Bud Chaos Warrior V
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Chaos Warrior V. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Chaos Warrior Vs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Emerging Chaos Warrior V
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.name: Wisp Primordial N'kari

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Newborn Lightning Doom-wheel

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Lightning Doom-wheel

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Awakened Plague Rat Ogre

lore_summary: A creature of the Chaos Wastes, aligned with Chaos energy. Known among tamers as a Lupine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Chaos tamers are called Champions. Bond is formed through combat — the tamer must fight the monster and either win or earn its respect through bravery in defeat.

base_chain.name: Spawn Singed Fleshhound
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Singed Fleshhound. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Chaos Wastes. Singed Fleshhounds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Singed Fleshhound
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Chaos — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Chaos Wastes. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Singed Fleshhound
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Singed Fleshhound bears the aesthetic of Chaos Wastes — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Chaos crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Chaos Wastes. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  strength is the only law. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Singed Fleshhound
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Chaos Wastes-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Berserker Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Chaos Wastes, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster
